description: Development-only. Grants the inspection plugin's guest binding commands for console.* forwarding and tool support. manage_ipc records only IPC calls an agent issues through the plugin's own tools; ordinary frontend invokes are not intercepted. No other plugin command is reachable from a window; every other inspection tool travels over the plugin's authenticated Unix socket, not through IPC. The plugin itself is registered only by a debug build that also selects the non-default `agent-inspection` feature, so this grant has no effect on a release artifact.
